sut.name: bookinfo
sut.deploy: SPECIFIED: k8s with Istio sidecars + Jaeger; the productpage flow with ratings scaled to zero. Not currently deployed (bookinfo scaled to 0 for the TrainTicket tenancy window).

readback.locator: no durable read-back (nominal: this is a read-path degradation, no write is intended); the discriminator is the trace, not durable state.

config.note: ratings made unavailable (scale-to-zero or toxiproxy). The reviews service catches the failed ratings call and degrades by design.

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Designed graceful degradation: the reviews service catches a failed ratings call and productpage still returns HTTP 200 with 'Ratings service is currently unavailable' (developer-intended, istio/istio PR #15489). The downstream error span is real, but the entry behaviour is correct-by-design, so this is benign - the canonical false-positive trap for any naive 'error span under a 2xx' oracle.

provenance.notes: Stratum-2 benign trap. naive_span_error_oracle FLAGS this (false positive) because a ratings error span sits under a 2xx entry; the TARGET for MIST's trace-shape oracle is no_flag (discriminate the designed degradation). tracetest_presence=no_flag: the ratings span IS present (the call is made and errors), so a presence-assertion passes -> unlike the error-span oracle, it does NOT false-positive here. mist_readback=not_applicable (none-durable: no data write to read back). The gap between naive_span_error (flag) and mist_trace_shape (no_flag) at matched recall is exactly the A1 ablation (precision/FP) the eval reports; the contrast with sockshop-shipping (where naive_span_error correctly flags a genuine masked failure) is the paired FP/TP datum. rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): readback modality none-durable + expect pair nominal; mist_dataintegrity_oracle -> mist_readback_oracle; ADDED tracetest_presence_oracle=no_flag. Status: SPECIFIED (not deployed).
